title: Tame geese
html_source: The ‘Wild Geese’ were the Irish Catholic soldiers who fled to the Continent after the Treaty of Limerick in 1691. There they served in the French, Spanish and Austrian armies. Davin has their ambition to serve in foreign armies but is intellectually domesticated.
